ideas.pitch: An AI-powered first-aid and emergency routing platform for pets that analyses symptom descriptions and distress audio to guide owners to the nearest open veterinary clinic.
ideas.title: PawPulse: Smart Pet Triage and Emergency Locator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the PetTech track in collaboration with PetsParivar, addressing a clear practical need with demonstrable multi-lingual symptom triage.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision garbage classification web app integrated with municipal bin fill-level sensors to optimize municipal waste collection routes in real-time.
ideas.title: EcoBin Vision: Smart Waste Classification and Collection Route Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a working computer vision model with clear measurable environmental impact and municipal logistics efficiency.

ideas.pitch: A geo-fenced campus emergency response app featuring one-tap duress alerts, live location streaming, and automated dispatch to campus security.
ideas.title: CampusGuard: Real-Time Student Safety and Incident Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable campus security problem with a working mobile-responsive panic button and live dashboard.

ideas.pitch: A matching platform for animal shelters that uses a questionnaire and temperament assessment algorithm to pair prospective adopters with rescues, reducing return rates.
ideas.title: AdoptMatch: AI-Driven Behavioral Compatibility for Shelters
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with PetsParivar's core focus by solving adoption friction with a data-driven matching algorithm.

ideas.pitch: An educational accessibility tool that converts complex lecture PDFs and whiteboard images into simplified audio summaries, dyslexia-friendly fonts, and sign language video prompts.
ideas.title: InclusiveLearn: Multi-Modal AI Document Reader for Accessible Classrooms
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates high social impact under the AI & Smart Technology track by solving real-world inclusive education hurdles.
